    static class Palindrome {
        public int isPalindrome(long xx) {
            List<Integer> v = new ArrayList<>();
            for (long x = xx; x > 0; x /= 10) {
                v.add((int)(x % 10));
            }
            int n = v.size();
            for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
                if (!v.get(i).equals(v.get(n - i - 1))) return 0;
            }
            return 1;
        }
    }

    static class BigNumber {
        public String add(String s1, String s2) {
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            int n1 = s1.length(), n2 = s2.length();
            int a = 0;
            for (int i = n1 - 1, j = n2 - 1; i >= 0 || j >= 0; i--, j--) {
                int x1 = i >= 0 ? s1.charAt(i) - '0' : 0;
                int x2 = j >= 0 ? s2.charAt(j) - '0' : 0;
                int sum = x1 + x2 + a;
                sb.append(sum % 10);
                a = sum / 10;
            }
            if (a > 0) sb.append(a);
            return sb.reverse().toString() + "\n";
        }
    }

    static class PrimeNumber {
        int N;
        boolean[] NP;
        List<Integer> P;

        public PrimeNumber(int n) {
            N = n;
            NP = new boolean[N + 1];
            P = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 2; i * i <= N; i++) {
                if (NP[i]) continue;
                for (int j = i * i; j <= N; j += i) {
                    NP[j] = true;
                }
            }
            for (int i = 2; i <= N; i++) {
                if (!NP[i]) P.add(i);
            }
        }

        public long gcd(long x, long y) {
            while (x != 0) {
                long z = y % x;
                y = x;
                x = z;
            }
            return y;
        }

        public long powermod(long p, long q) {
            long g = gcd(p, q);
            p /= g;
            q /= g;
            return p * _powmod(q, INF - 2) % INF;
        }

        private long _powmod(long a, long b) {
            if (b == 0) return 1;
            if ((b & 1) == 1) return a * _powmod(a, b - 1) % INF;
            long half = _powmod(a * a % INF, b / 2);
            return half;
        }

        public List<Integer> factorization(int x) {
            List<Integer> ret = new ArrayList<>();
            if (x == 1) {
                ret.add(1);
                return ret;
            }
            ret.add(1);
            ret.add(x);
            for (int i = 2; i * i <= x; i++) {
                if (x % i == 0) {
                    ret.add(i);
                    ret.add(x / i);
                }
            }
            if (Math.sqrt(x) == (int)Math.sqrt(x)) ret.add((int)Math.sqrt(x));
            return ret;
        }

        public int factorization2(int x) {
            int ret = 0;
            if (x == 1) return 1;
            ret = 2;
            for (int i = 2; i * i < x; i++) {
                if (x % i == 0) ret += 2;
            }
            if ((int)Math.sqrt(x) * (int)Math.sqrt(x) == x) ret++;
            return ret;
        }
    }

    static class Comb {
        long[][] C;
        long[] F;
        int N;
        static final long MOD = INF;

        public Comb(int n) {
            init(n);
        }

        public void init(int n) {
            N = n;
            C = new long[N + 1][];
            for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
                C[i] = new long[i + 1];
            }
            for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
                C[i][0] = 1;
                C[i][i] = 1;
            }
            for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                    C[i][j] = (C[i - 1][j - 1] + C[i - 1][j]) % MOD;
                }
            }
            F = new long[N + 1];
            F[0] = 1;
            for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
                F[i] = (F[i - 1] * i) % MOD;
            }
        }

        public long getC(int n, int r) {
            return C[n][r];
        }

        public long getF(int n) {
            return F[n];
        }

        public long get_comb(int n, int r) {
            if (n == r || r == 0) return 1;
            if (n <= 1000) return getC(n, r);
            long ret = 1;
            if (r > n / 2) r = n - r;
            for (int i = n; i > n - r; i--) ret *= i;
            for (int i = 2; i <= r; i++) ret /= i;
            return ret;
        }
    }

    static class Sort {
        int N;
        int[] tmp;

        public Sort(int n) {
            N = n;
            tmp = new int[n + 4];
        }

        public void merge_sort(List<Integer> x, int lo, int hi) {
            if (lo >= hi) return;
            int mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
            merge_sort(x, lo, mid);
            merge_sort(x, mid + 1, hi);
            int i = lo, j = mid + 1, k = lo;
            while (i <= mid && j <= hi) {
                if (x.get(i) < x.get(j)) tmp[k] = x.get(i++);
                else tmp[k] = x.get(j++);
                k++;
            }
            while (i <= mid) tmp[k++] = x.get(i++);
            while (j <= hi) tmp[k++] = x.get(j++);
            for (int idx = lo; idx <= hi; idx++) {
                x.set(idx, tmp[idx]);
            }
        }
    }

        public int[] makeSum(int[] a, int n) {

            ret[0] = a[0];
            for (int i = 1; i < a.length; i++) {
                ret[i] = ret[i - 1] + a[i];
            }
            return ret;

        public int[][] makeSum(int[][] a, int n, int m) {
            int[][] ret = new int[n][m];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                ret[i][0] = a[i][0];
                for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                    ret[i][j] = ret[i][j - 1] + a[i][j];
                }
            }
            return ret;
        }

        public int getSum(int[] psum, int a, int b) {
            if (a == 0) return psum[b];
            return psum[b] - psum[a - 1];
        }

        public int getSum(int[][] psum, int r1, int c1, int r2, int c2) {
            int ret = psum[r2][c2];
            if (r1 > 0) ret -= psum[r1 - 1][c2];
            if (c1 > 0) ret -= psum[r2][c1 - 1];
            if (r1 > 0 && c1 > 0) ret += psum[r1 - 1][c1 - 1];
            return ret;
        }
    }

    static class DisjointSet {

        public DisjointSet(int n) {

            int px = find_set(x);
            int py = find_set(y);

                P[py] = px;

            int j = len[0] - 1;
            while (i != -1) {

            long lv = _query(left, right, node * 2, nodeLeft, mid);

    static class SegmentTree2D {
        int N, M;
        int[][] P;
        Point[] T;

        public SegmentTree2D(int n, int m) {
            N = n;
            M = m;
            P = new int[N + 1][M + 1];
            T = new Point[N * M * 2];
            init();
            build(1, 1, 1, N, M);
        }

        public void init() {
            Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
            for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= M; j++) {
                    P[i][j] = sc.nextInt();
                }
            }
        }

        public Point build(int node, int a1, int b1, int a2, int b2) {
            if (a1 > a2 || b1 > b2) return def();
            if (a1 == a2 && b1 == b2) {
                return T[node] = new Point(a1, b1, P[a1][b1]);
            }
            T[node] = def();
            T[node] = maxNode(T[node], build(4 * node - 2, a1, b1, (a1 + a2) / 2, (b1 + b2) / 2));
            T[node] = maxNode(T[node], build(4 * node - 1, (a1 + a2) / 2 + 1, b1, a2, (b1 + b2) / 2));
            T[node] = maxNode(T[node], build(4 * node + 0, a1, (b1 + b2) / 2 + 1, (a1 + a2) / 2, b2));
            T[node] = maxNode(T[node], build(4 * node + 1, (a1 + a2) / 2 + 1, (b1 + b2) / 2 + 1, a2, b2));
            return T[node];
        }

        public Point query(int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2) {
            return _query(1, 1, 1, N, M, x1, y1, x2, y2);
        }

        private Point _query(int node, int a1, int b1, int a2, int b2, int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2) {
            if (x1 > a2 || y1 > b2 || x2 < a1 || y2 < b1 || a1 > a2 || b1 > b2) return def();
            if (x1 <= a1 && y1 <= b1 && a2 <= x2 && b2 <= y2) return T[node];
            Point mx = def();
            mx = maxNode(mx, _query(4 * node - 2, a1, b1, (a1 + a2) / 2, (b1 + b2) / 2, x1, y1, x2, y2));
            mx = maxNode(mx, _query(4 * node - 1, (a1 + a2) / 2 + 1, b1, a2, (b1 + b2) / 2, x1, y1, x2, y2));
            mx = maxNode(mx, _query(4 * node + 0, a1, (b1 + b2) / 2 + 1, (a1 + a2) / 2, b2, x1, y1, x2, y2));
            mx = maxNode(mx, _query(4 * node + 1, (a1 + a2) / 2 + 1, (b1 + b2) / 2 + 1, a2, b2, x1, y1, x2, y2));
            return mx;
        }

        public Point update(int x, int y, int value) {
            return _update(1, 1, 1, N, M, x, y, value);
        }

        private Point _update(int node, int a1, int b1, int a2, int b2, int x, int y, int value) {
            if (a1 > a2 || b1 > b2) return def();
            if (x > a2 || y > b2 || x < a1 || y < b1) return T[node];
            if (x == a1 && y == b1 && x == a2 && y == b2) {
                return T[node] = new Point(x, y, value);
            }
            Point mx = def();
            mx = maxNode(mx, _update(4 * node - 2, a1, b1, (a1 + a2) / 2, (b1 + b2) / 2, x, y, value));
            mx = maxNode(mx, _update(4 * node - 1, (a1 + a2) / 2 + 1, b1, a2, (b1 + b2) / 2, x, y, value));
            mx = maxNode(mx, _update(4 * node + 0, a1, (b1 + b2) / 2 + 1, (a1 + a2) / 2, b2, x, y, value));
            mx = maxNode(mx, _update(4 * node + 1, (a1 + a2) / 2 + 1, (b1 + b2) / 2 + 1, a2, b2, x, y, value));
            T[node] = mx;
            return mx;
        }

        private Point maxNode(Point a, Point b) {
            return a.mx > b.mx ? a : b;
        }

        private Point def() {
            return new Point(0, 0, -INF);
        }
